errors.text_span: “华山”、“嘉兴”、“临安”和“江南”的出现频次均在120至140次之间
errors.evidence: The description claims the frequencies for 嘉兴 (Jiaxing), 临安 (Lin'an), and 江南 (Jiangnan) are between 120 and 140. However, the chart shows their values are approximately 110, 100, and 95 respectively, all of which are below 120. Only 华山 (Huashan) is in the stated range (approx. 130).
